workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: BaseModelResponseIterator falsely terminates stream when tool-call arguments contain "[DONE]"
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(streaming): exact-match the SSE [DONE] marker in BaseModelResponseIterator. Target files: litellm/llms/base_llm/base_model_iterator.py, tests/unit/llms/base_llm/test_base_model_iterator.py. The proxy treated any streamed chunk containing the text [DONE] as the end of the stream, so that chunk was thrown away. A streamed tool call whose arguments include [DONE] vanished on chat completions, the Responses API and the messages endpoint, and the client got a plain stop instead, which agent loops read as an empty final answe... (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/47832)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: /v1/messages/count_tokens returns 500 for a `search_result` block, and for any content block type the local counter does not list
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(anthropic): count search results and reject unsupported token-count blocks. Target files: litellm/litellm_core_utils/token_counter.py, litellm/proxy/anthropic_endpoints/endpoints.py, litellm/types/llms/anthropic.py. Counting tokens for Anthropic search results now works on locally counted models, including search results inside tool results. Unsupported content blocks return a useful 400 error instead of a 500, while other counting failures keep their existing behavior (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48699)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Cohere chat sends a string stop as a string stop_sequences, the API expects a list
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cohere): map string stop parameter to list of strings for stop_sequences. Target files: litellm/llms/cohere/chat/transformation.py, litellm/llms/cohere/chat/v2_transformation.py, tests/unit/llms/cohere/chat/test_cohere_transformation.py. : Cohere chat API reference documents `stop_sequences` as a list of up to 5 strings (`stop_sequences: List[str]`). (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/47091)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Responses stream returns dict part when logprobs is omitted, breaking event.part.text
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(responses): preserve typed parts when logprobs is omitted. Target files: litellm/types/llms/openai.py, tests/unit/llms/openai/responses/test_openai_responses_http.py, tests/unit/types/llms/test_types_llms_openai.py. Responses streaming now preserves typed text parts when a provider omits optional logprobs, so applications can read `event.part.text` without an AttributeError. Explicit null, empty lists, and populated values retain their behavior (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48686)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: MCP REST OpenAPI loader rejects YAML documents
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(mcp): accept YAML OpenAPI documents. Target files: litellm/proxy/mcp_server/openapi_to_mcp_generator.py, tests/unit/proxy/mcp_server/test_mcp_server_manager.py, tests/unit/proxy/mcp_server/test_openapi_spec_path_url.py. YAML OpenAPI specs now generate MCP tools from URLs and local files. JSON keeps its existing decoding behavior, and both formats use the same loader for preview, registration, and health checks (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48622)

workarounds.symptom: [Feature]: Accept images on /v1/systemone and /v1/decisions for hosted_vllm decision models
workarounds.workaround: Fix: feat(hosted_vllm): accept images on decision deployments. Target files: litellm/llms/hosted_vllm/decisions/transformation.py, tests/unit/decisions/test_main.py. hosted_vllm decision deployments now accept images on /v1/decisions and /v1/systemone and pass them to vLLM's /v1/systemone `images` field, the same way LM Studio deployments already do. Before this, the gateway refused any image with a 400 before calling vLLM, even though current vLLM accepts images there. Remote https image URLs are inlined as data URLs before sen... (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48621)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Databricks decisions route ignores OAuth M2M credentials and returns 401 "Missing API key"
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(databricks): reuse base OAuth for decisions (#48395). Target files: litellm/llms/databricks/agent/transformation.py, litellm/llms/databricks/common_utils.py, litellm/llms/databricks/decisions/transformation.py. Databricks decisions requests return 401 when you configure OAuth M2M credentials without a static API key. Decisions now delegates token exchange and caching to DatabricksBase, which also owns the cache used by the agent route. Configured static keys keep their precedence, and tokens refresh 60 seconds before ex... (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48527)

workarounds.symptom: [Feature]: Support LM Studio decision models through the Decisions API
workarounds.workaround: Fix: feat(decisions): support LM Studio decision models. Target files: litellm/__init__.py, litellm/_lazy_imports_registry.py, litellm/llms/lm_studio/decisions/transformation.py. Requests go to LM Studio's native System One endpoint, with typed question and response translation handled by the shared Decisions pipeline (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48448)

workarounds.symptom: Non-object JSON request body (e.g. [], 123) returns 500 instead of 400 (AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'get' in pre_db_read_auth_checks)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(proxy): validate JSON object bodies before request handling. Target files: litellm/proxy/auth/auth_exception_handler.py, litellm/proxy/common_utils/http_parsing_utils.py, tests/unit/proxy/auth/test_auth_exception_handler.py. Object-only API requests now return a clear 400 for nonobject JSON instead of crashing request parsing or auth error handling. Optional body defaults, protobuf handling and existing pass-through behavior are preserved (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48438)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Groq rejects the next turn after a streamed reasoning reply because reasoning_content is sent back
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(groq): replay streamed reasoning replies without HTTP 400 (#47931). Target files: litellm/llms/groq/chat/transformation.py, tests/unit/llms/groq/chat/test_groq_chat_transformation.py. Apps can reuse a streamed Groq reply as conversation history without getting HTTP 400 on the next turn. workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Gemini models can't be accessed through SDK
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(llms): join api_base and route with one shared helper. Target files: litellm/litellm_core_utils/url_utils.py, litellm/llms/aiml/image_generation/transformation.py, litellm/llms/aiohttp_openai/chat/transformation.py. An `api_base` that ends in `/` makes most provider URL builders put `//` in the request path, and a gateway that keeps `//` (a default-config Envoy, or Mistral's own API) answers 404. This adds `join_api_base` and `ensure_api_route` to `url_utils` and moves every builder that joins a caller-set `api_base` on... (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/47535)
